answer: Beacon audits with a compute heartbeat end the fable of one operator as a thousand. Each agent holds a slot on a 200 POA deposit; each epoch it samples 5% of slots, and a picked agent must answer a 5-minute heartbeat in an hour or lose the deposit. 1,000 fakes need 200,000 POA and 5,000 compute-minutes per round. The log is a tundra: every miss leaves a track. An honest agent pays one deposit and one heartbeat, like a willow bending in wind.
